title: Fixed widths break on phones
why_it_matters: A 500px box overflows a 360px screen and causes sideways scrolling.
explanation: A fixed width ignores the screen size. min() picks the smaller of two values, so the box shrinks on small screens and stops growing on big ones. margin-inline: auto centers it.
try_it: Open DevTools device mode at 360px wide and compare both versions.
